hints: Use server transport when the agent needs remote, auth-enabled execution through nextstat-server.
Treat descriptor.tools as the only callable server surface and use descriptor.capabilities to explain why local-only tools are unavailable remotely.
When server auth is enabled, pass api_key explicitly or provide NEXTSTAT_TOOLS_API_KEY / NEXTSTAT_SERVER_API_KEY.

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, upload the requested ROOT file bytes, read the requested TH1 histogram in memory without assuming server-side filesystem access, summarize suspicious bins and under or overflow content, then continue with deterministic workspace validation and fit checks.
recipes.summary: Upload bounded ROOT bytes to nextstat-server, read TH1 histograms remotely in memory, then continue with the regular HEP inference tools on the derived workspace.
recipes.title: Server-safe ROOT ingest and workspace triage

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, audit this workspace, fit it, and report a short asymptotic CLs summary, observed and expected 95% CL upper limit, and a short profile scan summary. If the workspace is pyhf or HS3, also include discovery significance and top nuisance impacts by default. If it is simplified-likelihood, treat audit + fit + asymptotic CLs/upper-limit + scan as the promoted stable subset and use discovery, ranking, or toy CLs only when the user explicitly asks for the compatibility-tested surface. Use deterministic mode and do not assume local-only tools are available.
recipes.summary: Remote, auth-aware HEP inference chain over nextstat-server using the restricted server-safe subset. For simplified-likelihood inputs, discovery, ranking, and toy CLs remain compatibility-tested rather than promoted stable.
recipes.title: Server-safe workspace inference

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, fit the requested GLM deterministically, report the coefficient estimates and standard errors, and keep the analysis on the server-safe subset without assuming local-only tools are available.
recipes.summary: Run bounded generalized linear model fits remotely through nextstat-server without relying on local-only Python tooling.
recipes.title: Server-safe GLM analysis

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, run bounded Bayesian NUTS sampling on the requested server-safe model, keep the request inside the authenticated sample-budget limits, and report posterior means plus convergence diagnostics rather than raw posterior draws.
recipes.summary: Run bounded NUTS sampling remotely over the promoted server-safe model subset and return posterior mean summaries plus convergence diagnostics.
recipes.title: Server-safe Bayesian summary sampling

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, fit the requested survival, Kaplan-Meier, direct log-rank, or competing-risks analysis deterministically, report fitted parameters or incidence-curve outputs with any log-rank or Gray-test comparison when requested, and stay within the authenticated server-safe subset.
recipes.summary: Run bounded survival-model, Kaplan-Meier, direct log-rank, and competing-risks analyses remotely through nextstat-server without relying on local-only Python tooling.
recipes.title: Server-safe survival analysis

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, run the requested seeded churn data generation, Cox PH churn-risk analysis, churn retention, raw-array ingest and validation, bounded bootstrap hazard-ratio analysis, trust-gate diagnostics, cohort life-table matrix, pairwise churn comparison, bounded uplift analysis, or survival-native uplift analysis deterministically, report synthetic or normalized churn arrays, Cox PH coefficients and hazard-ratio summaries, bootstrap HR summaries with explicit CI settings, overall survival, diagnostics warnings, cohort retention periods, pairwise segment-comparison outputs, causal uplift summaries, or RMST/survival-difference summaries with explicit statistical settings, and stay within the authenticated server-safe subset.
recipes.summary: Run bounded synthetic churn generation, churn-risk modeling, churn-retention, churn ingest, bootstrap HR, churn diagnostics, cohort-matrix, churn-comparison, and churn-uplift analyses remotely through nextstat-server using deterministic JSON-only inputs and authenticated server execution.
recipes.title: Server-safe churn retention analysis

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, run the requested ads variance-reduction adjustment deterministically, keep covariates strictly pre-treatment, and report adjusted means, treatment effect, variance-reduction diagnostics, selected covariates, provenance validation, and solver metadata without assuming local-only helpers are available.
recipes.summary: Run deterministic CUPED or CURE adjustment remotely through nextstat-server using JSON-only ads inputs and provenance-aware leakage validation.
recipes.title: Server-safe ads variance reduction

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, run the requested chain ladder or Mack chain ladder analysis deterministically, normalize square triangles with null trailing cells when needed, and report development factors, ultimates, reserves, and uncertainty bands without assuming local-only tools are available.
recipes.summary: Run deterministic chain ladder or Mack chain ladder reserving remotely through nextstat-server using JSON-only triangle inputs and authenticated server execution.
recipes.title: Server-safe reserving analysis

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, run the requested fault-tree Monte Carlo or CE-IS analysis deterministically on CPU, report the estimated top-event probability, uncertainty interval, failure counts, and proposal diagnostics when available, and stay within the authenticated server-safe subset without assuming GPU or local-only tools are available.
recipes.summary: Run bounded CPU-only fault-tree Monte Carlo or Bernoulli-only CE-IS analysis remotely through nextstat-server using deterministic JSON-only inputs.
recipes.title: Server-safe fault-tree Monte Carlo

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, run the requested fixed-effects or random-effects meta-analysis deterministically, report the pooled estimate, uncertainty, heterogeneity statistics, and forest rows, and stay within the authenticated server-safe subset.
recipes.summary: Run bounded fixed-effects or random-effects meta-analysis remotely through nextstat-server using deterministic JSON-only inputs.
recipes.title: Server-safe meta-analysis

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, run the requested panel fixed-effects regression deterministically, keep the workflow inside the authenticated server-safe subset, and report coefficients, clustered standard errors, entity counts, and the effective clustering mode without assuming local-only tools are available.
recipes.summary: Run bounded panel fixed-effects regressions remotely through nextstat-server using deterministic JSON-only inputs and authenticated server execution.
recipes.title: Server-safe panel econometrics

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, run the requested Difference-in-Differences TWFE analysis deterministically, keep the workflow inside the authenticated server-safe subset, and report the ATT, its uncertainty, and the clustered coefficient surface without assuming local-only tools are available.
recipes.summary: Run bounded Difference-in-Differences TWFE analyses remotely through nextstat-server using deterministic JSON-only inputs and authenticated server execution.
recipes.title: Server-safe DiD analysis

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, run the requested IV / 2SLS analysis deterministically, keep the workflow inside the authenticated server-safe subset, and report structural coefficients, uncertainty, and first-stage F diagnostics without assuming local-only tools are available.
recipes.summary: Run bounded IV / 2SLS analyses remotely through nextstat-server using deterministic JSON-only inputs and authenticated server execution.
recipes.title: Server-safe IV / 2SLS analysis

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, run the requested AIPW causal analysis deterministically, keep the workflow inside the authenticated server-safe subset, and report the estimand, treatment effect estimate, uncertainty, and observation count without assuming local-only tools are available.
recipes.summary: Run bounded doubly-robust AIPW causal analyses remotely through nextstat-server using deterministic JSON-only inputs and authenticated server execution.
recipes.title: Server-safe AIPW causal analysis

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, run the requested event-study TWFE analysis deterministically, keep the workflow inside the authenticated server-safe subset, and report the relative-time coefficients, uncertainty, and reference period without assuming local-only tools are available.
recipes.summary: Run bounded event-study TWFE analyses remotely through nextstat-server using deterministic JSON-only inputs and authenticated server execution.
recipes.title: Server-safe event-study analysis

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, run the requested GARCH-family volatility analysis deterministically, keep the workflow inside the authenticated server-safe subset, and report fitted parameters, conditional variance paths, and convergence diagnostics without assuming local-only tools are available.
recipes.summary: Run bounded GARCH-family volatility analyses remotely through nextstat-server using deterministic JSON-only inputs and authenticated server execution.
recipes.title: Server-safe volatility analysis

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, run the requested Kalman filter, smoother, or forecast deterministically, keep the workflow inside the authenticated server-safe subset, and report log-likelihood, state trajectories, and forecast paths without assuming local-only tools are available.
recipes.summary: Run bounded Kalman filtering, smoothing, or forecasting remotely through nextstat-server using deterministic JSON-only inputs and authenticated server execution.
recipes.title: Server-safe state-space analysis

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, run the requested bioequivalence test, power, or sample-size calculation deterministically, keep the workflow inside the authenticated server-safe subset, and report the geometric mean ratio, power, or achieved sample size without assuming local-only tools are available.
recipes.summary: Run bounded average bioequivalence, power, or sample-size calculations remotely through nextstat-server using deterministic JSON-only inputs and authenticated server execution.
recipes.title: Server-safe bioequivalence analysis

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, run the requested Emax or Sigmoid-Emax dose-response prediction or likelihood evaluation deterministically, keep the workflow inside the authenticated server-safe subset, and report predictions or NLL values without assuming local-only tools are available.
recipes.summary: Run bounded Emax or Sigmoid-Emax dose-response predictions and likelihood evaluations remotely through nextstat-server using deterministic JSON-only inputs and authenticated server execution.
recipes.title: Server-safe dose-response analysis

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, fit the requested population PK model deterministically using the promoted nextstat_pharma_fit contract, report theta, omega, ETA summaries, OFV, convergence status, and any covariance-step or SAEM diagnostics that are returned, and when the user asks for bounded diagnostics, run nextstat_pk_gof, nextstat_pk_npde, or nextstat_pharma_vpc inside the authenticated server-safe subset with explicit deterministic inputs without assuming broader trial-simulation tools are available remotely.
recipes.summary: Run bounded FOCE, FOCEI, FO, or SAEM population PK fits remotely through nextstat-server using deterministic JSON-only inputs, and run promoted GOF, NPDE, or VPC follow-up diagnostics when requested.
recipes.title: Server-safe population PK fitting

recipes.prompt: Over the remote server, run the requested single-trial PK simulation deterministically using nextstat_trial_simulate, keep the workflow inside the authenticated server-safe subset, report concentration profiles, individual PK parameters, and derived endpoints (AUC, Cmax, Tmax, Ctrough), and do not assume Monte Carlo, dose-optimization, or other broader trial-simulation APIs are available remotely.
recipes.summary: Run bounded single-trial PK simulations remotely through nextstat-server using deterministic JSON-only inputs and explicit seeds.
recipes.title: Server-safe PK trial simulation

function.description: Run Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) on a HistFactory model; simplified-likelihood input is inside the promoted March 2026 stable subset. Input workspace_json is a pyhf-style, HS3-style, or simplified-likelihood JSON workspace string.

execution.description: Optional execution controls. If deterministic=true (default), NextStat will attempt to enforce parity-friendly settings (threads=1, eval_mode='parity') where supported.

deterministic.description: If true, prefer deterministic parity behavior (default: true).

workspace_json.description: JSON string of the pyhf, HS3, or simplified-likelihood workspace. Auto-detected.

function.description: Read a TH1 histogram from uploaded ROOT file bytes entirely in memory on nextstat-server, including sumw2 and under/overflow bins.
function.name: nextstat_read_root_histogram

execution.description: Optional execution controls. If deterministic=true (default), NextStat will attempt to enforce parity-friendly settings (threads=1, eval_mode='parity') where supported.

deterministic.description: If true, prefer deterministic parity behavior (default: true).

eval_mode.description: Evaluation mode. 'parity' favors numerical stability; 'fast' may use approximations.

threads.description: Requested thread count. If omitted and deterministic=true, defaults to 1. If 0, use library default.

filename_hint.description: Optional filename hint used for diagnostics when reading ROOT bytes from memory.

hist_path.description: Histogram path/key inside the uploaded ROOT file (e.g. 'dir/hist').

root_bytes_base64.description: Base64-encoded ROOT file bytes. Server-safe ROOT ingest uses in-memory bytes and does not read arbitrary paths from the server filesystem.

function.description: Fit a Generalized Linear Model (GLM). Supports linear, logistic, Poisson, and negative binomial regression. Returns coefficients, standard errors, and predictions. Input is tabular: X (2D array of features), y (1D array of outcomes).
function.name: nextstat_glm_fit

include_intercept.description: Whether to include an intercept term. Default: true.

x.description: Feature matrix (2D array, each inner array is one observation).

function.description: Run bounded Bayesian NUTS sampling on the authenticated server-safe model subset. Returns convergence diagnostics and posterior mean summaries only; raw posterior draws remain local-only.
function.name: nextstat_bayesian_sample

model_id.description: Optional cached HistFactory model identifier (histfactory only).

model_type.description: Type of server-safe model to sample from.

n_chains.description: Number of MCMC chains for the bounded server-safe subset. Range: 1-4.

n_levels.description: Number of ordinal outcome levels (ordered logit/probit only).

n_samples.description: Number of post-warmup draws per chain. Range: 1-1000.

n_warmup.description: Number of warmup draws per chain. Range: 1-500.

seed.description: Random seed for deterministic parity runs.

target_accept.description: Target acceptance rate for NUTS. Range: 0.5-0.99.

x.description: Feature matrix (regression, Cox, and ordinal models).

function.description: Fit a survival model via MLE. Supports Cox PH, Weibull, Log-Normal AFT, and Exponential models. Returns parameter estimates (log-hazard ratios or AFT coefficients), standard errors, and NLL. Input: X (covariates), time (event/censoring times), event (1=event, 0=censored).
function.name: nextstat_survival_fit

function.description: Compute the Kaplan-Meier survival curve and optionally a log-rank test. Returns time points, survival probabilities, confidence intervals, and number at risk. If group labels are provided, also returns a log-rank test.
function.name: nextstat_kaplan_meier

group.description: Optional group labels for log-rank test (e.g. 0/1 for two arms).

function.description: Run a bounded direct log-rank (Mantel-Cox) test remotely across two or more survival groups. Returns the chi-squared statistic, p-value, degrees of freedom, and per-group observed versus expected event totals.
function.name: nextstat_log_rank_test

events.description: Event indicators. Accepts booleans or 0/1 integers.

groups.description: Integer group labels for the survival comparison.

times.description: Observation times from event or censoring follow-up.

function.description: Fit a panel data model with entity fixed effects (within estimator). Returns coefficients with cluster-robust standard errors. Equivalent to Stata's xtreg, fe.
function.name: nextstat_panel_fe

time.description: Optional time identifiers (required for cluster='time' or 'two_way').

function.description: Estimate a Difference-in-Differences (DiD) model via two-way fixed effects (TWFE). Returns the ATT (average treatment effect on the treated) with cluster-robust SE.
function.name: nextstat_did

function.description: Estimate an Instrumental Variables (IV) model via Two-Stage Least Squares (2SLS). Returns structural coefficients, standard errors (homoskedastic, HC1, cluster-robust, or HAC), and first-stage F-statistics for weak instrument diagnostics.
function.name: nextstat_iv_2sls

max_lag.description: Maximum Newey-West lag when cov='hac'. Default: automatic.

function.description: Estimate a doubly-robust Average Treatment Effect (ATE or ATT) via Augmented Inverse Probability Weighting (AIPW). Returns the estimand, treatment effect estimate, standard error, and observation count.
function.name: nextstat_aipw

estimand.description: Estimand: ATE or ATT. Default: ate.

function.description: Run a meta-analysis (fixed or random effects). Input: effect sizes and their standard errors from multiple studies. Returns pooled estimate, confidence interval, heterogeneity statistics (I², Q, tau²).
function.name: nextstat_meta_analysis

standard_errors.description: Standard errors of each study's effect.

function.description: Run Kalman filtering, smoothing, forecasting, deterministic simulation, or bounded EM re-estimation on a linear state-space model over the authenticated server-safe subset.
function.name: nextstat_kalman

alpha.description: Two-sided forecast interval alpha in (0,1). Used when operation='forecast'.

estimate_f.description: Whether EM should re-estimate F. Currently meaningful for 1D models only. Default: false.

estimate_h.description: Whether EM should re-estimate H. Currently meaningful for 1D models only. Default: false.

estimate_q.description: Whether EM should re-estimate Q. Default: true.

estimate_r.description: Whether EM should re-estimate R. Default: true.

init.description: Initial state strategy for simulation when simulate_x0 is omitted. Default: sample.

max_iter.description: Maximum EM iterations when operation='em'. Server-safe subset additionally bounds this value. Default: 50.

min_diag.description: Minimum covariance diagonal floor used by EM. Default: 1e-12.

n_ahead.description: Number of steps to forecast ahead (forecast mode only). Default: 10.

seed.description: Random seed used for simulation. Default: 42.

simulate_x0.description: Optional override for the simulated initial state mean. Used when operation='simulate'.

t_max.description: Number of simulated time steps when operation='simulate'. Server-safe subset caps this value.

tol.description: Relative tolerance for EM convergence. Default: 1e-6.

y.description: Observation sequence (each element is an observation vector).

function.description: Apply one-covariate CUPED adjustment as the one-covariate case of the shared CURE layer over the authenticated server-safe subset. Only pre-treatment covariates are supported. Returns adjusted means, effect, variance-reduction diagnostics, selected covariates, provenance validation, and solver metadata.
function.name: nextstat_ads_cuped_adjust

control_covariates.description: One pre-treatment covariate value per control observation.

covariate_name.description: Optional human-readable covariate name for logging and artifact surfaces.

covariate_provenance.description: Optional typed provenance metadata for fail-fast leakage validation. timing must remain pre_treatment for promoted production use.

pre_treatment_only.description: Keep fail-fast pre-treatment-only validation enabled. Default: true.

variant_covariates.description: One pre-treatment covariate value per variant observation.

function.description: Apply multivariate CURE adjustment with SVD/ridge collinearity guardrails over the authenticated server-safe subset. Only pre-treatment covariates are supported. Returns adjusted means, effect, variance-reduction diagnostics, selected covariates, provenance validation, and solver metadata.
function.name: nextstat_ads_cure_adjust

covariate_names.description: Optional selected covariate names for logging and artifact surfaces.

covariate_provenance.description: Optional typed provenance metadata, one item per covariate, for fail-fast leakage validation.

pre_treatment_only.description: Keep fail-fast pre-treatment-only validation enabled. Default: true.

function.description: Generate a seeded synthetic churn dataset over the authenticated server-safe subset. Server execution stays deterministic and enforces bounded customer/cohort counts.
function.name: nextstat_churn_generate_data

n_cohorts.description: Number of synthetic signup cohorts. Server-safe execution rejects values above 24.

n_customers.description: Number of synthetic customers to generate. Server-safe execution defaults to 256 and rejects values above 1024.

treatment_fraction.description: Fraction of generated customers assigned to treatment. Must be in [0,1]. Default: 0.3.

function.description: Fit a bounded Cox PH churn risk model remotely and return coefficients, standard errors, hazard ratios, and confidence intervals for the requested covariates.
function.name: nextstat_churn_risk_model

conf_level.description: Confidence level used for hazard-ratio confidence intervals. Must be in (0,1). Default: 0.95.

covariates.description: Rectangular covariate matrix with one row per observation.

events.description: Churn indicators. Accepts booleans or 0/1 integers.

names.description: Covariate names matching the covariate column count.

times.description: Observation times from signup to churn or censoring.

function.description: Compute churn retention using stratified Kaplan-Meier summaries and a log-rank comparison. Returns the overall survival curve, per-group retention summaries, and the log-rank test.
function.name: nextstat_churn_retention

conf_level.description: Confidence level used for the Kaplan-Meier summaries. Default: 0.95.

events.description: Churn indicators. Accepts booleans or 0/1 integers.

groups.description: Group labels for stratified retention summaries and the log-rank comparison.

times.description: Observation times from signup to event or censoring.

function.description: Compare churn segments with pairwise log-rank tests, hazard-ratio proxies, and multiple-comparisons correction over the authenticated server-safe subset.
function.name: nextstat_churn_compare

alpha.description: Significance threshold used to mark pairwise results as significant. Default: 0.05.

conf_level.description: Confidence level used for median retention summaries. Default: 0.95.

correction.description: Multiple-testing correction method. Accepts 'benjamini_hochberg' (alias 'bh') or 'bonferroni'. Default: benjamini_hochberg.

events.description: Churn indicators. Accepts booleans or 0/1 integers.

groups.description: Segment labels for the pairwise churn comparison.

times.description: Observation times from signup to event or censoring.

function.description: Run bounded churn-analysis trust-gate diagnostics over the authenticated server-safe subset: censoring rates by segment, covariate balance, optional propensity-overlap checks, and warning summaries for downstream retention or uplift analysis.
function.name: nextstat_churn_diagnostics

covariate_names.description: Optional covariate names aligned with the covariate matrix columns.

function.description: Run chain ladder or Mack chain ladder reserving on a cumulative claims triangle. Accepts either a ragged upper-left triangle or a null-filled square triangle and returns development factors, ultimates, IBNR, and (for Mack) uncertainty metrics.
function.name: nextstat_chain_ladder

conf_level.description: Confidence level for Mack prediction intervals. Default: 0.95.

method.description: basic = deterministic chain ladder; mack = with prediction errors. Default: mack.

triangle.description: Cumulative claims triangle as either a ragged upper-left triangle or a null-filled square matrix. In square form, only the upper-left triangle is used.

function.description: Fit a nonlinear mixed-effects (NLME) population PK model using FOCE, FOCEI, FO, or SAEM. Supports the promoted JSON-only PopPK contract remotely through nextstat-server.
function.name: nextstat_pharma_fit

doses.description: Per-subject dose amounts (length = n_subjects, or length 1 for broadcast).

execution.description: Optional execution controls. If deterministic=true (default), NextStat will attempt to enforce parity-friendly settings (threads=1, eval_mode='parity') where supported.

deterministic.description: If true, prefer deterministic parity behavior (default: true).

eval_mode.description: Evaluation mode. 'parity' favors numerical stability; 'fast' may use approximations.

threads.description: Requested thread count. If omitted and deterministic=true, defaults to 1. If 0, use library default.

omega_init.description: Initial omega diagonal elements (IIV standard deviations).

sigma_add.description: Additive residual error magnitude. Required when error_model='combined'.

theta_init.description: Initial population PK parameter estimates (e.g. [CL, V, Ka] for 1cpt_oral).

times.description: Flat array of observation times across all subjects.

y.description: Flat array of observed concentrations (same length as times).

function.description: Run a bounded Visual Predictive Check (VPC) for a fitted population PK model through nextstat-server. Simulates replicate datasets with an explicit seed and returns per-bin observed and simulated quantile envelopes.
function.name: nextstat_pharma_vpc

doses.description: Per-subject dose amounts (length = n_subjects, or length 1 for broadcast).

n_bins.description: Number of time bins used to summarize the VPC. Default: 10.

pi_level.description: Prediction-interval level for simulated envelopes. Default: 0.90.

quantiles.description: Quantile levels to summarize per time bin. Default: [0.05, 0.50, 0.95].

sigma_add.description: Additive residual error magnitude. Required when error_model='combined'.

function.description: Run bounded population PK goodness-of-fit diagnostics through nextstat-server using deterministic JSON-only inputs. Returns PRED, IPRED, IWRES, and CWRES records for each observation.
function.name: nextstat_pk_gof

doses.description: Per-subject dose amounts (length = number of ETA rows, or length 1 for broadcast).

error_model.description: Residual error model used for GOF diagnostics. Default: proportional.

sigma_add.description: Additive residual error magnitude. Required when error_model='combined'.

function.description: Run bounded NPDE diagnostics for a population PK model through nextstat-server using deterministic JSON-only inputs and an explicit seed. Returns per-observation percentiles plus NPDE values, along with overall mean and variance summaries.
function.name: nextstat_pk_npde

doses.description: Per-subject dose amounts (length = n_subjects, or length 1 for broadcast).

error_model.description: Residual error model used for NPDE diagnostics. Default: proportional.

n_sim.description: Number of simulated replicates per observation. Default: 500.

sigma_add.description: Additive residual error magnitude. Required when error_model='combined'.

function.description: Simulate a bounded single clinical PK trial through nextstat-server using deterministic JSON-only inputs. Returns concentration profiles, individual parameters, and derived PK endpoints for each subject.

bioavailability.description: Oral bioavailability fraction. Used for oral models only. Default: 1.0.

dose.description: Single dose amount applied to every subject at time 0.

error_model.description: Residual error model for the simulated observations. Default: proportional.

function.description: Run average bioequivalence (ABE) analysis on a 2x2 crossover study. Returns geometric mean ratio, 90% CI, and BE conclusion. Optionally compute power or sample size.

gmr.description: Assumed geometric mean ratio (for power/sample_size). Default: 0.95.

operation.description: test=run ABE, power=compute power, sample_size=compute N.

ref_values.description: Log-transformed AUC/Cmax for reference formulation (for 'test' operation).

test_values.description: Log-transformed AUC/Cmax for test formulation (for 'test' operation).

function.description: Run bounded CPU-only Monte Carlo simulation on a fault tree (FTA) remotely. Returns top-event failure probability, uncertainty interval, and component importance measures.

n_scenarios.description: Number of Monte Carlo scenarios. Default: 1000000.

spec.description: Fault tree specification: {components: [{type, ...}], nodes: [{type:'component', index} or {type:'and'/'or', children}], top_event: idx}. Component types: {type:'bernoulli', p:float}, {type:'bernoulli_uncertain', mu:float, sigma:float}, {type:'weibull_mission', k:float, lambda:float, mission_time:float}.

function.description: Run bounded CPU-only Cross-Entropy Importance Sampling (CE-IS) on a fault tree remotely for rare-event probability estimation. Current server-safe CE-IS component support is Bernoulli-only.

elite_fraction.description: Elite fraction for CE update. Default: 0.01.

q_max.description: Upper cap for adaptive proposal probabilities. Default: 0.99.

spec.description: Fault tree specification with Bernoulli-only components for server-safe CE-IS.

function.description: Evaluate an Emax or Sigmoid-Emax dose-response model. Returns predicted response at given concentrations, or NLL when observed responses are provided.

conc.description: Concentration values for prediction or likelihood evaluation.
